steps.title: Open the Anthropic console
steps.body: Your key is created on Anthropic's website, not here. Iris will wait while you sign in.

hints: If a sign-in page appeared instead, sign in and you will land on the keys page.
Already signed in elsewhere? The console may open straight to your keys.

steps.title: Click "Create Key"
steps.body: Give it a name you will recognise later — the app it is for is a good one. Choose an expiry you are comfortable with; a key that never expires is one you will forget you made.

hints: The button is at the top right of the API keys page, labelled "Create Key".
If it is greyed out, the name field is probably still empty.

steps.title: Copy the key
steps.body: Anthropic shows the key exactly once. Copy it now — if you lose it you will have to make another. Iris stops looking at your screen for this step.

hints: The key starts with sk-ant- and is only shown on this screen once.

steps.title: Paste it into Iris
steps.body: Open Iris settings and paste the key into the Anthropic key field. It is stored in your Keychain and is never sent to publik — only to Anthropic, from your machine.

steps.title: Check it works
steps.body: Iris will make one tiny request to confirm the key is valid. If it fails, the usual cause is a missing character at the start or end of the paste.

expect.prompt: Does the settings panel show the Anthropic key as valid or accepted?

hints: A key with no credits authenticates but cannot be used — check Plans & Billing if it reports a balance problem.
